source_tasks.problem: Choose between one and 4 distinct digits from the set {1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9} and arrange the chosen digits without repetition to form a positive integer. How many distinct prime numbers can be formed?

Using up to 4 digits from the set {0, 1, 3, 4, 6, 9}, arrange the digits without repetition to make positive integers. A leading zero is not allowed. What is the number of distinct prime integers obtainable?

Using up to 4 digits from the set {0, 1, 3, 5, 6, 7}, arrange the digits without repetition to make positive integers. A leading zero is not allowed. What is the number of distinct prime integers obtainable?
From one to 4 digits may be selected from the set {0, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9} and arranged without repetition as a positive integer. A leading zero is not allowed. How many distinct prime numbers result?
Choose between one and 4 distinct digits from the set {1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9} and arrange the chosen digits without repetition to form a positive integer. How many distinct prime numbers can be formed?

Choose between one and 4 distinct digits from the set {0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8} and arrange the chosen digits without repetition to form a positive integer. A leading zero is not allowed. How many distinct prime numbers can be formed?

Using up to 4 digits from the set {0, 1, 5, 6, 7, 8}, arrange the digits without repetition to make positive integers. A leading zero is not allowed. What is the number of distinct prime integers obtainable?

interface_note: Only parameter values vary; all mathematical conditions and requested quantity remain those stated by the supplied source questions. Names describe source data, not a target algorithm. Implement solve(parameters), no natural-language applicability detection. max_length must not exceed the number of distinct supplied digits.
